projects.title: Logic and proof technique
projects.blurb: Propositions and truth tables, normal forms, proofs as Lean tactics, quantifiers, three kinds of induction, relations and well-founded termination: the toolkit every later course uses.

lessons.title: Propositions and truth tables
lessons.blurb: Connectives, truth tables, tautologies, and satisfying assignments as witnesses.

lessons.title: Equivalence and normal forms
lessons.blurb: The laws of logic as rewrites: negation normal form, CNF and DNF, one law a step.

lessons.title: Proofs as Lean tactics
lessons.blurb: Natural deduction in Lean: introduce and use each connective, and see proofs as programs.

lessons.title: Predicates and quantifiers
lessons.blurb: ∀ and ∃ over finite sets, with the element that decides them; quantifiers in Lean.

lessons.title: Induction on the natural numbers
lessons.blurb: Weak induction: check a formula for small n, then prove it for all n in Lean.

lessons.title: Strong induction
lessons.blurb: Course-of-values arguments: using every smaller case, and how strong induction, weak induction and well-ordering relate.

lessons.title: Structural induction
lessons.blurb: Induction on lists, trees and expressions, and a small simplifier proved sound.

lessons.title: Relations
lessons.blurb: Properties with counterexamples, closures step by step, equivalence classes and partitions, and a deduplication bug.

lessons.title: Well-founded relations and termination
lessons.blurb: No infinite descent: cycles as counterexamples, measures as proofs, and termination in Lean.

projects.title: Order and lattices
projects.blurb: From Zero to Propagators: partial orders, lattices and fixed points; semilattices as merges, access decisions and information flow; Galois connections; and propagator networks in Lean, ending with a Sudoku solver.

lessons.title: Relations and partial orders
lessons.blurb: Partial orders on numbers, divisibility and sets, Hasse diagrams, and the definitions in Lean.

lessons.title: Special elements and monotone maps
lessons.blurb: Least, greatest, maximal and minimal elements, bounds, joins and meets, and monotone maps.

lessons.title: Lattices
lessons.blurb: Posets where every pair has a join and a meet: duality, the standard examples, and distributivity.

lessons.title: Complete lattices and fixed points
lessons.blurb: Complete lattices, the Knaster–Tarski theorem, and least fixed points by iteration.

lessons.title: Semilattices as algebras
lessons.blurb: Join as an operation with laws: associative, commutative, idempotent, and the order it gives back.

lessons.title: A merge is a join
lessons.blurb: Max, union, last-writer-wins and records merged field by field: why replicas that merge this way agree.

lessons.title: Distributive and Boolean lattices
lessons.blurb: M₃ and N₅ as the witnesses, complements, and the Boolean lattices of sets and squarefree divisors.

lessons.title: Access decisions
lessons.blurb: Combining permit and deny: deny-overrides and permit-overrides are joins, first-applicable is not commutative.

lessons.title: Information flow
lessons.blurb: Denning's lattice of security classes: data may only flow up, and a computation's output gets the join of its inputs' classes.

lessons.title: Closure operators and Galois connections
lessons.blurb: Closure operators, Galois connections between two orders, and the concept lattice of a formal context.

lessons.title: Fixed points in practice
lessons.blurb: Apply until nothing changes: reachability as a least fixed point, and why the iteration stops.

lessons.title: The propagator model
lessons.blurb: Cells that only gain information, in a lattice; propagators as monotone functions between them.

lessons.title: A propagator network in Lean
lessons.blurb: Mutable cells that only grow, a scheduler that runs to quiescence, and a constraint that runs in every direction.

lessons.title: The interval lattice
lessons.blurb: Bounds on a number as partial information: intersection as the merge, and interval arithmetic propagators.

lessons.title: Capstones: Sudoku and type inference
lessons.blurb: A Sudoku solver and a type checker, both as propagator networks over lattices of partial information.

projects.title: Calculus: derivatives and integrals
projects.blurb: The rules of differentiation, the chain rule and tangent lines; then antiderivatives the engine checks by differentiating, definite integrals and Riemann sums.

lessons.title: The rules of differentiation
lessons.blurb: Powers, sums, constant multiples and products: four rules, every step named.

lessons.title: The chain rule
lessons.blurb: Functions of functions: the outer derivative times the inner one, with a slider to watch the inner factor.

lessons.title: Higher derivatives and tangent lines
lessons.blurb: Derivatives of derivatives, slopes at a point, and the tangent line that follows a slider.

lessons.title: Antiderivatives, checked
lessons.blurb: Integration as the search for a function whose derivative you know, accepted only after the engine differentiates it back.

lessons.title: Definite integrals and sums
lessons.blurb: The fundamental theorem of calculus, finite sums, and Riemann sums that close in on the area as a slider adds rectangles.

projects.title: Linear algebra: vectors, matrices and systems
projects.blurb: Vectors and the dot product, matrix arithmetic, solving systems by row reduction with verified row operations, and determinants.

lessons.title: Vectors and the dot product
lessons.blurb: Adding and scaling vectors, lengths, and the dot product that measures angles.

lessons.title: Matrices
lessons.blurb: Matrix arithmetic, the product that is not commutative, the transpose, and a matrix acting on a vector.

lessons.title: Solving systems by row reduction
lessons.blurb: An augmented matrix, the three row operations (each proved to keep the solutions), and reading the answer off the reduced form.

lessons.title: Determinants
lessons.blurb: The determinant of 2×2 and 3×3 matrices, the product rule, and what a zero determinant means.

projects.title: λ-calculus: computing by reduction
projects.blurb: Terms, β-reduction in normal order and why substitution must avoid capture; then numbers, arithmetic and booleans built from functions alone.

lessons.title: β-reduction
lessons.blurb: Applying a function by substituting its argument, one redex at a time, and the renaming that keeps substitution honest.

lessons.title: Church numerals and booleans
lessons.blurb: Numbers as repeated application, arithmetic as composition, and booleans as choice.

projects.title: Explorations
projects.blurb: Notebooks that show what ChalkMath does: a tour, Fourier series drawing a llama, and order theory with its proofs in Lean.

lessons.title: Welcome to ChalkMath
lessons.blurb: A short tour: running cells, reading the steps, and one example from each area.

lessons.title: Drawing llamas with circles
lessons.blurb: Fourier series from inner products to epicycles, ending with a llama drawn by spinning circles.

lessons.title: Order and lattices
lessons.blurb: Part I of From Zero to Propagators: partial orders, joins and meets, monotone maps and fixed points, with the proofs in Lean cells.
